en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a cobbled town square with several children and adults standing in the foreground. Surrounding the square are historic multi‑story buildings, and prominently in the background rises a large church with two tall Gothic towers. The left side of the card has open blank space, while the right side contains the town view. Red German text appears at the upper left and along the left margin.
